chunk:a966ff66-74bb-45a9-8ff0-ce78e86d22.passage: Our Business Engineering Growth. Enabling Progress. At Kaynes, our business segments reflect our transformation from a service-oriented EMS provider into a product- driven ESDM enterprise. This evolution is focused on delivering high-value, vertically integrated solutions that enable us to capture a larger share of the electronics value chain. As a trusted integrated ESDM partner to global OEMs, we offer a comprehensive portfolio that spans ideation, embedded design, advanced component manufacturing, semiconductor packaging, and global end-to-end lifecycle support. Through this integrated ecosystem, we help customers accelerate innovation, strengthen supply-chain reliability, and achieve greater manufacturing confidence. Product Design and Engineering Our design and engineering capabilities form the foundation of our integrated ESDM platform, where customer requirements are translated into manufacturable, high-reliability electronic systems. We offer a structured suite of engineering services that spans the entire product lifecycle, from concept development through to production, working closely with global customers at every stage of the development cycle. Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) We remain a trusted partner of choice for global and domestic leaders, delivering world-class, zero-defect manufacturing solutions at scale.
